chapter: Postwar: Chicago, Vinson, Hines and Cootie
title: Other drummers in New York
summary: Dance and Gus list New York drummers: Specs Powell, Cozy Cole, Harold West, Max Roach and Kenny Clarke.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, actually, what -- it's just a little interesting there, because I was saying to you, there weren't that many good drummers. Well, there was Specs Powell, there was --
Yeah, there was Spec. He was working studios and all like that.
Yeah. But -- and there was Cozy.
Cozy Cole. And there was a guy named
Harold West, he was a good drummer. Everybody always used Harold West when I [came back.] Everybody was talking about Harold West.
: Because he came up under Kenny Clark.
